cover: Tear gas in Imphal; Kuki man shot dead

stories.label: World · Life & safety
stories.head: Drone strike on a border market
bullets: Abyei's caretaker information minister says the toll rose from 73 to 153, with fires still burning.
MSF says it is treating more than 20 wounded, some with severe burns.
South Sudan blames Sudan's army; a Sudanese officer told AP it hit RSF-bound fuel tankers and does not target civilians.

stories.label: India · Life & safety
stories.head: Tear gas at a protest in Imphal
bullets: Protesters over Monday's killing of three Meitei villagers tried to enter an event attended by the Chief Minister.
Police fired tear gas; three people had minor injuries.
A Kuki man, Paolen Khongsai, was shot dead on Tuesday; police arrested three in Monday's ambush.

stories.label: India · Due process
stories.head: Jantar Mantar protesters released
bullets: A magistrate ordered the release of Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka on Wednesday.
The court rejected a police request for three more days' custody.
Two dozen UN experts urged an inquiry into force used at the protests; India says police acted within the law.

stories.label: India · Land
stories.head: Mosque near PM's residence told to go
bullets: The Land and Development Office calls the mosque unauthorised on government land.
The Delhi Waqf Board says it is Waqf property notified in 1977.
Nearly 700 nearby families were displaced; police say they got homes in Mundka.
